description: Create up to 100 test cases in one request — the batch form of qase_case_upsert, and the right tool whenever more than one case is being written. Takes a list of cases with the same fields and the same enum handling as qase_case_upsert: labels ("high", "blocker") or numeric IDs both work, steps classic or Gherkin. The batch is validated as a whole, so an invalid item means nothing is created, and each item is then reported individually. Returns the IDs in the order submitted. This creates only; to change an existing case use qase_case_upsert with its `id`. Cost: one API call regardless of batch size. Ten cases measured 1.2s here against 5.6s as ten separate qase_case_upsert calls — four times faster and one tenth of the calls. Split larger imports across several calls.

cases.description: Test cases to create, 1 to 100 per call

automation.description: Automation status (label, slug, or numeric ID: 0=Manual / is-not-automated, 1=To be automated, 2=Automated)

custom_field.description: Custom field values keyed by field ID, e.g. { "12": "value" }

description.description: Free-form description of what the case covers

is_flaky.description: Is flaky label or numeric ID (0=No, 1=Yes). A boolean is accepted too.

milestone_id.description: ID of the milestone the case belongs to

postconditions.description: State to restore or verify after the steps run

preconditions.description: State the system must be in before the steps run

priority.description: Priority label or numeric ID (0=not set, 1=high, 2=medium, 3=low)

steps.description: Ordered test steps; omit for a case without steps

action.description: Step action (classic steps). Not needed when `shared` is set.

shared.description: Hash of an existing shared step to insert at this position, from `qase_shared_step_upsert`. The step then reuses that shared step instead of defining its own content, so `action` can be omitted. Reading the case back reports the link as `shared_step_hash`.

shared_step_hash.description: Alias for `shared` — the name used when reading a case. Sent to the API as `shared`.

steps.description: Nested substeps. Same structure as parent steps, supports further nesting.

action.description: Step action (classic steps). Not needed when `shared` is set.

shared.description: Hash of an existing shared step to insert at this position, from `qase_shared_step_upsert`. The step then reuses that shared step instead of defining its own content, so `action` can be omitted. Reading the case back reports the link as `shared_step_hash`.

shared_step_hash.description: Alias for `shared` — the name used when reading a case. Sent to the API as `shared`.

steps_type.description: How steps are written: "classic" action/expected pairs, or "gherkin" scenario text

suite_id.description: ID of the suite that holds the case

code.description: Project code (2-10 uppercase letters, numbers, or underscores)
